blurb: South Coast Sailing Adventures offers sailing lessons, captained cruises, bareboat charters, and overnight accommodations aboard sailboats at Seabrook Marina. Their school is an American Sailing Association Certified Training Facility with ASA certified instructors and USCG licensed captains. They provide internationally recognized certification programs and a large fleet of sailboats for various sailing experiences.
